matches.description: Watch Samsunspor vs Yeni Çorumspor highlights and goals from Süper Lig on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on September 12, 2026. The Süper Lig encounter on September 12, 2026 , delivered a high-octane performance that left fans breathless from the opening whistle. As Samsunspor and Besiktas faced off, the tactical battle on the pitch evolved into a clinical scoring spectacle. A Whirlwind Opening The match began with an intensity rarely seen, as Jesus Ramirez found the back of the net in the very first minute, setting a frantic pace for the evening. Before the visitors could even catch their breath, the advantage was doubled in the 5th minute when Logi Tomasson converted a chance created by Emre Kilinc . The onslaught continued as Cengiz Under took center stage, scoring twice in quick succession. His first goal arrived in the 10th minute following a Fredy assist, and he struck again in the 15th minute after being played through by Mohamed Diomande , leaving the opposition stunned by a four-goal blitz in the opening quarter-hour. Tactical Adjustments and Substitutions As the first half progressed, the tempo eventually settled, though the physical nature of the game increased, evidenced by a yellow card for Gokhan Sazdagi in the 31st minute. Following the halftime break, both managers looked to their benches to influence the flow. Berat Ozdemir replaced Mohamed Diomande early in the second period, while a flurry of changes around the hour mark saw the introduction of Youssoufa Moukoko and Ermin Mahmic . These tactical shifts provided fresh energy as the contest entered its final stages, ensuring the intensity remained high despite the early lead. Closing the Chapter The drama was far from over in the second half. In the 69th minute, Alexandros Kyziridis produced a clinical finish assisted by the newly introduced Ermin Mahmic . However, the response was immediate; just two minutes later, Jesus Ramirez secured his brace in the 71st minute after excellent work from Gokhan Sazdagi . Despite late bookings for Ylber Ramadani and Andrei Borza , and further substitutions including Haluk Mustafa Tan and Alexandre Penetra , the scoreline remained unchanged until the final whistle at 90+3 minutes, concluding a breathless Süper Lig fixture.

matches.title: Samsunspor vs Fenerbahce
matches.description: Watch Samsunspor vs Fenerbahce highlights and goals from Süper Lig on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 30, 2026. The Süper Lig delivered another captivating chapter as Samsunspor faced off against Fenerbahce . With both teams eager to climb the table, the match promised high-octane action and tactical discipline from the very first whistle. Early Breakthrough for the Visitors On August 30, 2026, the game ignited almost immediately. Within just three minutes, Fenerbahce took the lead through a clinical attacking move. Oguz Aydin turned provider, delivering a sharp assist to Vedat Muriqi , who made no mistake in finding the back of the net. Samsunspor found themselves on the back foot early on and were dealt another blow in the 16th minute when Fatih Kaya was forced off due to injury, replaced by Anto Sekongo . The remainder of the first half saw Fenerbahce controlling the tempo, though Samsunspor remained disciplined in their defensive shape. The home side struggled to create clear-cut chances, and the teams headed into the break with the visitors holding a slender but deserved advantage. Doubling the Advantage and Tactical Shifts The second half began much like the first, with Fenerbahce showing superior efficiency. In the 49th minute, the lead was doubled. Irfan Kahveci showcased his vision with a brilliant pass to Oguz Aydin , who capped off a fine individual performance by scoring himself. Down by two, Samsunspor attempted to claw their way back, introducing Afonso Sousa to spark some creativity in the final third. As the clock ticked past the hour mark, Fenerbahce introduced star power to see the game out. Romelu Lukaku and Ismail Yuksek replaced Vedat Muriqi and Mason Greenwood respectively. The physical nature of the contest increased, leading to a yellow card for Lukaku in the 70th minute as he looked to impose himself on the match. Closing Stages and Final Whistle The final ten minutes were characterized by a flurry of substitutions as both managers looked to manage energy levels. In the 86th minute, a quadruple change saw players like Bartug Elmaz and Levent Mercan enter the fray for the visitors, while Samsunspor brought on Tahsin Bulbul and Samed Onur in a last-ditch effort to alter the scoreline. Ultimately, Fenerbahce ’s defensive organization proved too strong for the hosts. After four minutes of stoppage time, the referee blew the final whistle, confirming a professional and well-executed victory for the Istanbul giants on their travels.
